question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The killing of a king
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Regicide"** means the act of killing a king. (राजा की हत्या)

 
 
• **Example: **The historical account of regicide shocked the entire kingdom.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fratricide** (भ्रातृहत्या): The act of killing one's brother.

 
 
• **Example:** The tale of fratricide in the royal family was both tragic and shocking.
 
 
 
• **Sororicide** (भगिनीहत्या): The act of killing one's sister.
 
 
• **Example: **The crime of sororicide left the community in disbelief.
 
 
 
• **Patricide** (पितृहत्य): The act of killing one's father.
 
 
• **Example:** He was charged with patricide after the investigation.
